verdict.rationale: The payment-acceptance docs name the accepted stablecoins, USDC and USDT, from any wallet or a Coinbase account. Chain coverage is only named piecemeal in other product contexts: Base for USDC subscriptions and agentic wallet trading, EVM and Solana for the wallet SDK, and "multiple networks" for the wallet MCP. There is no consolidated matrix of supported assets and networks for checkout or deposits. missing for 10: an explicit per-product list of supported stablecoins and named networks for payment acceptance and deposit destinations, stablecoins beyond USDC/USDT, and independent corroboration.
